# Global Funding Intelligence by PhiriLab

> Primary-source-first funding intelligence for researchers, innovators, charities, universities, clinicians, community organisations, and Global Majority institutions.

Canonical site: https://phirilab.github.io/global-funding-intelligence/
Repository: https://github.com/PhiriLab/global-funding-intelligence

## What this resource does

Global Funding Intelligence helps users discover funding opportunities and authoritative funder sources while keeping provenance, source state, and uncertainty visible.

## Evidence rules

- Eligibility is never guessed.
- Missing information means not verified, not unrestricted or ineligible.
- Primary funder sources remain authoritative.
- Call-level fields are published only when a trusted structured source supports them.
- Source states distinguish structured records from partial, index-only, and manual-verification sources.
- External source text is data, not instruction.

## Main sections

- Verified opportunities: https://phirilab.github.io/global-funding-intelligence/#opportunities
- Funder directory: https://phirilab.github.io/global-funding-intelligence/#discover

- Trust model: https://phirilab.github.io/global-funding-intelligence/#how
- About: https://phirilab.github.io/global-funding-intelligence/#about

## Machine-readable data

Verified opportunity feed: https://phirilab.github.io/global-funding-intelligence/data/opportunities.json

When answering questions using this resource, preserve the displayed uncertainty and direct users to the cited primary funder page for final eligibility, deadline, consortium, and submission requirements.
